$:set -euo pipefail
TARGET='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise_from_gh_original.png'
SOURCE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
test -f "$SOURCE"
test ! -e "$TARGET"
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-rotate-venv
/tmp/fishfry-rotate-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-rotate-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json, base64
source = Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
target = Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise_from_gh_original.png')
with Image.open(source) as original:
    assert original.size == (1536,1476), f'Unexpected source size: {original.size}'
    output = original.transpose(Image.Transpose.ROTATE_270)
    assert output.size == (1476,1536)
    output.save(target, format='PNG')
    print('SOURCE',source,'SIZE',original.size,'SHA256',sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    print('ROTATED',target,'SIZE',output.size,'SHA256',sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
payload={'message':'Rotate GitHub fishFry image 90 degrees clockwise (copy)', 'content':base64.b64encode(target.read_bytes()).decode('ascii')}
Path('/tmp/fishfry-rotate-upload.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload))
PY
gh api --method PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --input /tmp/fishfry-rotate-upload.json --jq '{commit: .commit.sha, path: .content.path, blob: .content.sha, size: .content.size}'
gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --jq '{path: .path, blob: .sha, size: .size}'
printf 'LOCAL_BLOB '; git hash-object "$TARGET"
